spec.name: Furniture Aquarium
spec.description: A wide, open-top aquarium on a low walnut cabinet, with pale blue glass, clear blue water, two orange fish, tall aquatic plants and pale gravel. Fits within 0.25-unit outer margins; front faces negative Z.

prompt: Create an original vanilla Minecraft furniture model: rectangular glass aquarium on a low dark wooden cabinet, blue water, two orange fish, green aquatic plants and pale gravel; use pale blue transparent glass with visible fish. Grounded attractive survival-server furniture. Entire model fits x=0..32, y=0..32, z=0..16; floor y=0, front negative Z. 16 units per Minecraft block. Keep a 0.25-unit margin at outer x/z edges.  Use 8-30 purposeful axis-aligned cuboids, no rotations, no bones, no animation. Detailed hand-painted pixel art, coherent palette, explicit non-overlapping cube-net UVs with correct texel density. Connected physical structure, no z fighting, no stand outside the furniture. No text labels, no surrounding scene. Generate the whole piece with its distinctive silhouette and materials.
